description: Bootstrap assets for current legal, medical, and local knowledge QA families. These assets are not globally stable semantics.

change_log.summary: Initial externalized domain bootstrap config extracted from classifier.py.
changes: Moved domain QA patterns out of classifier.py into a dedicated config asset.
Moved domain hint and self-anchor tokens into config for future dynamic maintenance.

change_log.summary: Expanded configurable domain anchors for group-scoped intent assets.
changes: Added configurable judgment anchors, missing-history blockers, clarify exemptions, and complex QA anchors.
Prepared classifier knowledge signals for group-specific asset isolation.
